chronology: Base 3-grid study already running; this specifies additional checks before their execution. No base acceptance threshold is changed.
heat_balance_definition: Sum signed convective and conductive numerical boundary fluxes, with enthalpy datum 300K, divided by nominal rho*cp*U*W*H*(Tw-Tin)=0.28944 W. Upwind outlet uses owner-cell T; fixed inlet uses imposed T; orthogonal wall/inlet diffusion uses actual half-cell distance. Report raw signed watts. This normalization was selected before the first successful postprocessing, after a mesh-only setup attempt.

stationarity.scope: Continue each converged flow and main thermal result with convergence stop disabled; compare full fields and primary pressure/temperature QoIs before versus after. Keep the primary reported fields unchanged, label this a diagnostic continuation.

outlet_sensitivity.comparison: Same mesh spacing/properties/inlet; compare numerical upwind flux-weighted temperature at the original 30mm plane with the original medium-grid outlet
outlet_sensitivity.interpretation: Measures medium-grid outlet-location sensitivity only; does not bound all boundary-condition/model error

budget: All additional CFD counted within original 2700-second solver wall-time and 3GB working-storage budget
